svg.title: Conservative Sequencing (~2 sprints with 2 engineers, incl. review cycles and buffer)

g.text: Conservative Sequencing (~2 sprints with 2 engineers, incl. review cycles and buffer)
Engineer A: S2 -> S3. Engineer B: S4 -> S5. S6 shared.
- S1 includes async review + one revision cycle, not just writing
- S2/S4 sized for CI auth debugging and permission surprises
- S6 waits on DEP and on pilot-team availability
- Prod-target verification in S2/S4 may slip until DEP lands
Working days only; ~3.5 weeks elapsed -> plan as 2 sprints with slack.
S1 ADR: CI/CD standard (incl. review cycles)
